authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 7727 pati explicitly means husband; its vernacular northern forms normally lose t (pai/poi). Kullui pətiː husband retains dental t and is linked as a learned Sanskrit loan, leaving any intra-Indo-Aryan intermediary open. Exact survey form pət̪iː is preserved.
